title: Feat/dynamic parameters early
body:
**Summary**

we need identical parameters with the initial search request (before widgets are known) and after widgets are mounted, so cache can deduplicate

**Result**

call getWidgetSearchParameters of all the children, get the non-managed parameters. This should work in theory, but it doesn't as the widgets aren't known until after `init`:

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/7d99ab95972d5886cdc82abb5794a41d38381a50/src/widgets/dynamic-widgets/dynamic-widgets.ts#L107-L119

if this is a solution we want to take, I need to push a single `fallbackWidget` into the widgets array

alternative: solve only for `maxValuesPerFacet`, as it's the only other parameter we set
